RC3-AUTH-001.finding: Production OIDC is runtime-proven against Google Identity Services using the RS256/JWKS signature-first verifier. A verified bound Google subject resolved through the application binding store and authenticated the member read path. Missing bearer traffic failed closed with HTTP 401.

RC3-BIND-001.finding: Runtime proof confirms a verified Google subject resolves to a durable application participant with ACTIVE membership and governed member scopes; the same member identity was denied operator access with HTTP 403. A valid Google subject with no matching application binding was denied member access with HTTP 403. A controlled disabled-binding falsification caused member access to fail closed with HTTP 403 and the binding was restored immediately afterward.

RC3-ENV-001.finding: Production OIDC issuer, audience, JWKS and DATABASE_URL configuration are present and runtime-proven during bounded identity-enabled rehearsals.

RC3-LOG-001.finding: Production runtime logs from the identity-enabled rehearsal showed route/status metadata for exercised OIDC paths without bearer token material, Google subject, issuer value or provider secret material.

RC3-PAY-001.finding: The currently claimed payment envelope is runtime-proven in real Paystack TEST mode on commit ee2179d0cc45c24dc678af8900164dd45322d8f2. Workflow run 34808988687 proved GHS 1.00 initiation, provider confirmation, delayed transaction re-query, refund creation, and six successful refund-status re-queries while the refund remained nonterminal PENDING. Executable tests prove exact raw-body HMAC-SHA512 webhook verification, bad-signature/tamper rejection, reference binding, provider-neutral semantics, idempotency controls, and test/live credential separation. Live merchant webhook delivery remains deliberately unclaimed because Paystack live mode and live funds are unauthorized.

RC3-ROLLBACK-001.finding: Rollback to fail-closed Production application access is runtime-proven. Final exact-candidate Production deployment dpl_CuXVr8MjtDYo76RAuEspbf4DBd66 is READY with productionApplicationAccessEnabled=false, and the canonical member-orders route returns HTTP 503 PRODUCTION_APPLICATION_ACCESS_DISABLED.

RC3-REHEARSAL-001.finding: The bounded Production identity-enabled rehearsal passed for the governed member positive path, unauthenticated member/operator denial, member-to-operator denial, valid-but-unbound Google subject denial, disabled application principal denial, log hygiene, and rollback behavior. No identity runtime residual remains.
